3 Game Pack! - Candy Land + Chutes and L.name: Candy Land / Chutes & Ladders / Original Memory Game
3 Game Pack! - Candy Land + Chutes and L.summary: This Hasbro board game compilation features the three board games of the same name. Each game gives the player the option to have each participant either be played by a person or the computer itself. "Candy Land" has participants try to navigate the location stated in the title to meet King Kandy. "Chutes & Ladders" involves spinning a six-space wheel to progress through the 10 x 10 space board. The first to reach space 100 wins the game. "Original Memory Game" plays the same as the card-matching game of concentration. The goal is to have the most points if competing with other players, or to find all matches if playing independently.

Land Before Time, The.name: The Land Before Time
Land Before Time, The.summary: The Land Before Time is a 2D platforming game developed by Full Fat for the Game Boy Advance. It was released in North America in February 2002, and Europe the following month, both published by Conspiracy Entertainment.

March of the Penguins.name: March of the Penguins
March of the Penguins.summary: The critically acclaimed story of love and survival in the world's harshest environment becomes a wondrous videogame journey! In the video game adaptation of the Oscar-winning film March of the Penguins you’ll guide loveable Emperor Penguins on their incredible journey for survival, defying the elements, in the name of life and family. This magical "edutainment" quest stars some of the most beloved animals on Earth ... and featuring some of the most dangerous predators and environments ever encountered.

Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell - Pandora Tom.name: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Pandora Tomorrow
Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell - Pandora Tom.summary: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Pandora Tomorrow is a stealth video game developed and published by Ubisoft Shanghai and Ubisoft Milan, while Ubisoft Montreal, developer of the original Splinter Cell, was working on Chaos Theory. Pandora Tomorrow is the second game in the Splinter Cell series endorsed by writer Tom Clancy. The game follows the covert activities of Sam Fisher, an agent working for a black-ops branch of the National Security Agency (NSA) called "Third Echelon". Sam Fisher is voiced by Michael Ironside. Dennis Haysbert voices the character Irving Lambert, Fisher's boss, making this the only time he is not voiced by Don Jordan. Lalo Schifrin provides the theme music for the game. A remastered high-definition version of Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Pandora Tomorrow was announced for the PlayStation Network for the PlayStation 3 on December 20, 2010.

Twin Series 7 - Twin Puzzle - Kisekae Wa.name: Twin Series Vol. 7: Twin Puzzle - Kisekae Wanko EX + Nyaa to Chuu no Rainbow Magic 2
Twin Series 7 - Twin Puzzle - Kisekae Wa.summary: Twin Series Vol. 7: Twin Puzzle: Kisekae Wanko EX + Nyaa to Chuu no Rainbow Magic 2 is a Puzzle game, developed and published by Culture Brain, which was released in Japan in 2004.

Wings.name: Wings
Wings.summary:
Take to the skies!

Relive the action, glory and seat of the pants daring of a WWI Allied fighter pilot! You'll strafe Hun armies, bomb enemy aerodromes and match wits against deadly Aces in heart stopping dogfights, the loser going down in flames… without a parachute!

More than just a simulator, Wings features genuine arcade action and an emotion packed role-playing experience. Wings is the easy to plan air combat simulation you've been waiting for… no complicated keyboard commands. Just fly and shoot!
